entry.name: DECO-50
entry.title: DECO: Decoupled Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation with a Plugin Tactile Adapter
entry.summary: Teleoperated Unitree H1-2 with two Inspire RH56DFTP hands (17 piezoresistive pads, 1,062 taxels per hand) on pick-and-place, sorting, waste-disposal and assembly tasks, with active stereo head camera, joint states and actions at 30 Hz.
entry.hand: Inspire RH56DFTP (6 DoF) x 2 on Unitree H1-2 (14-DoF arms, 2-DoF active camera head)

sensor.note: Per frame and hand: tactiles/<idx>_{left,right}_ee_tactile.npy, a flat (1062,) float64 vector of raw readings. 17 pads per hand (paper Table 10): 5 fingertips 3x3, 5 finger tops 12x8, 4 finger palms 10x8, thumb middle 3x3, thumb palm 12x8, palm 8x14. Normal force only. Raw range 0-4095 (statistics files: per-task maxima 3,827-4,095).

scale.text: Paper: 50+ h, ~5M frames, 8,000+ successful trajectories, 4 scenarios / 28 sub-tasks. HF release: 8,174 episode archives in 29 sub-task folders (task1 12, task2 3, task3 8, task4 6), 1.61 TB

entry.access: Hugging Face BAAI-Humanoid/DECO-50, ungated: one tar.gz per episode (median 185 MB, 1.61 TB total) holding JPEG frames, per-frame tactile .npy, data.json and data.pkl; four per-task statistics YAMLs.
caveats: Tactile is raw 12-bit counts (0-4095), normal force only; no N or kPa conversion is given.
The 1,062-value vector has no documented taxel order; data.json tactile_names is empty. Pad sizes come from the paper's Table 10.
No per-frame timestamps in data.json; the paper states 30 Hz logging. data.json info declares 640x480 images, but the released JPEGs are 1280x720.
data.json text fields are template placeholders in the checked episode ('task description', 'step1: do this; ...'); only the goal string ('pick up cube.') varies.
Sub-task folders (data-t1-1 ... data-t4-6) are not mapped to object names in the release; data.pkl condition_indx carries the per-object index.
Release counts differ from the paper: 29 sub-task folders and 8,174 episodes vs 28 sub-tasks and 8,000+ successful trajectories (Table 8: 8,021 successful of 10,622).
data.pkl is a pickled pandas DataFrame; load only in a trusted environment.

cameras.model: custom active binocular camera (yaw + pitch motors)
cameras.note: colors/<idx>_color_0.jpg (left) and _color_1.jpg (right); design files in GitHub assets/active_camera

tracking.system: Inspire RH56DFTP joint states (6 per hand) + Unitree H1-2 arms (7 per arm) + active camera (2)
tracking.note: states and actions in data.json; hand qpos normalized 0-1 (0.23-1.0 in the checked episode)
teleoperation: hand keypoints retargeted to the Inspire hands; not released as a stream
teleoperation: wrist pose -> IK for the arms; first-person stereo view streamed back to the headset

sources: https://arxiv.org/html/2602.05513 (v4, Appendix A: Tables 8-10, A.3 data collection)
https://huggingface.co/datasets/BAAI-Humanoid/DECO-50 (README.md, API info, full tree via paginated tree API)

https://huggingface.co/datasets/BAAI-Humanoid/DECO-50 task2/data-t2-1/episode_0416.tar.gz (38.6 MB; data.json, 111 frames of JPEG + tactile .npy; data.pkl strings listed with pickletools, not unpickled)
unconfirmed: episodes = 8,174 counted from episode_*.tar.gz files in the HF tree (per folder: t1 158/129/159/128/150/175/165/189/298/178/196/174 for t1-1..t1-12 in folder order 1-12; t2-1 824, t2-2 1,082, t2-3 792; t3-1 143, t3-2 133, t3-3..t3-8 150 each; t4-1 356, t4-2 300, t4-3 300, t4-4 318, t4-5 575, t4-6 352). Whether failed trajectories are included is not stated.

hours = 50 and frames = 5M are the paper's figures ('over 5M', 'approximately 5 million'); paper Table 8 sums to 48.7 h successful / 60.0 h total. Not recomputed from the release (frame counts need a full download per episode). 5M frames / 8,174 episodes ~ 610 frames ~ 20 s per episode at 30 Hz (derived).
tasks = 29 counts sub-task folders in the release; the paper and card say 28 sub-tasks, and Table 8 lists 25 object/variant rows.

objects = 20 derived from paper Tables 8-9: 12 foods in task 1, 3 3D-printed materials (00081, 00553, 00296) in tasks 2 and 4 (scaled 1.5x-3x), 4 waste items in task 3, plus the custom interference-fit pair.

Checked episode task2/data-t2-1/episode_0416: 111 frames (3.7 s at 30 Hz), shorter than typical (38.6 MB vs 185 MB median archive). Left-hand tactile 0-569 with 39 of 1,062 taxels ever non-zero; right-hand max 364 with 35 non-zero; both hands carry constant non-zero offsets on some taxels.
Camera resolution from the released JPEGs (1280x720 MJPEG); fps 30 from the paper's logging rate and data.json info. Camera model beyond 'custom active camera' not stated.
Hand qpos appears normalized to 0-1 (range in the checked episode); unit not stated. Arm qpos in -0.5..0.3, likely rad (not stated).
Secondary survey arXiv 2607.24744 lists DECO-50 as '8K / 50+' h, 28 tasks; it adds nothing beyond the paper.
zh: the project page names affiliation 1 as '星源智 (xyz-eai.com)'; BAAI appears only in English.

sample.reason: Apache-2.0 (HF card YAML and README 'This dataset is released under the Apache 2.0 license.') allows redistribution; repo is public and ungated. Label the collection 'Apache-2.0'.
sample.fetch_estimate: Episodes cannot be chosen without downloading: tactile sits inside per-episode tar.gz archives (median 185 MB). Plan: 3 candidate archives in each of 7 sub-tasks = 21 x ~185 MB ~ 3.9 GB, keep 7. Re-hosted media: one stereo view per episode re-encoded to H.264 from 1280x720 JPEGs (~10-20 MB per 20 s clip). Episode JSON: 2 x 1,062 values x ~600 frames per episode ~ 1.3M numbers, so store tactile as integers (values are whole counts) or crop to a contact window to stay under 2 MB.
sample.rules_applied: Tasks: 29 sub-task folders > 6, so take 7 spanning all 4 scenarios: task1 x 2 (different foods), task2 x 1, task3 x 2, task4 x 2 (different parts). One episode per sampled sub-task. Each must have both 1,062-value tactile vectors present, contact above the per-taxel rest offsets for >= 1 s, and 10-60 s length (cut to a contact window otherwise). Budget: <= 20 GB download, <= 2 MB JSON, ~30 MB media per episode.
deviations: Sub-task folders are not mapped to object names; the candidate's object is read from data.json text.goal and the paper's Table 8 order, and recorded as unconfirmed.
